payload.description:
A budget in CDK with an SNS topic to the owner, plus a hard cap on the OpenAI project set by hand in their console.

Why first: it is the only control that catches a bug in our own code. No authentication check ever will.

Done when: CDK defines a budget + SNS to the owner; README says the OpenAI project cap is a console action and is not in git. No --all. Development ThinTurn/web unchanged unless the budget stack requires a named deploy.
payload.title: Alarm on AWS spend before anything else changes
